=== if-else
--- main
!$n = 2
!if $n > 1
A -> B : many
!else
A -> B : one
!endif
=== if-elseif
--- main
!$n = 2
!if $n == 1
A : one
!elseif $n == 2
A : two
!elseif $n == 2
A : two again
!else
A : other
!endif
=== if-nested
--- main
!$a = 1
!$b = 0
!if $a
!if $b
A : a and b
!else
A : a not b
!endif
!else
!if $b
A : b not a
!endif
!endif
=== if-nested-false-elseif-evaluated
--- main
!if 0
!if 0
!elseif $missingfn()
A : x
!endif
!endif
A : done
=== if-false-skips-errors
--- main
!if 0
!$x = $missingfn()
!include missing.iuml
!assert 1 == 2
!endif
A : done
=== if-unclosed
--- main
!if 1
A : x
=== if-endif-without-if
--- main
A : x
!endif
=== if-else-without-if
--- main
!else
=== if-elseif-without-if
--- main
!elseif 1
=== if-uppercase
--- main
!IF 1
A : x
!ENDIF
=== if-missing-expression
--- main
!if
A : x
!endif
=== if-string-condition
--- main
!$s = "abc"
!if $s == "abc"
A : equal
!endif
!if $s
A : nonempty
!endif
=== if-double-else
--- main
!if 0
A : a
!else
A : b
!else
A : c
!endif
=== ifndef
--- main
!$x = 1
!ifndef $x
A : no x
!endif
!ifndef $y
A : no y
!endif
=== ifdef-else
--- main
!ifdef NOTDEFINED
A : yes
!else
A : no
!endif
=== while-loop
--- main
!$i = 0
!while $i < 3
A -> B : $i
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
=== while-false
--- main
!while 0
A : never
!endwhile
A : after
=== while-nested
--- main
!$i = 0
!while $i < 2
!$j = 0
!while $j < 2
A : $i $j
!$j = $j + 1
!endwhile
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
=== while-nested-false-skip
--- main
!while 0
!while 1
A : inner
!endwhile
A : outer
!endwhile
A : after
=== while-infinite
--- main
!$i = 0
!while 1
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
=== while-endwhile-without-while
--- main
!endwhile
=== while-missing-expression
--- main
!while
!endwhile
=== while-in-if
--- main
!$i = 0
!if 1
!while $i < 2
A : $i
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
!endif
=== while-998-iterations
--- main
!$i = 0
!while $i < 998
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
A : $i
=== while-1000-iterations
--- main
!$i = 0
!while $i < 1000
!$i = $i + 1
!endwhile
A : $i
=== foreach-array
--- main
!foreach $x in [1, 2, 3]
A : $x
!endfor
=== foreach-variable
--- main
!$list = ["a", "b"]
!foreach $item in $list
A : $item
!endfor
=== foreach-object
--- main
!$obj = {"k1": "v1", "k2": "v2"}
!foreach $k in $obj
A : $k
!endfor
=== foreach-empty
--- main
!foreach $x in []
A : $x
!endfor
A : after
=== foreach-objects-in-array
--- main
!$data = [{"name": "a", "v": 1}, {"name": "b", "v": 2}]
!foreach $e in $data
A : $e.name = $e.v
!endfor
=== foreach-nested
--- main
!foreach $a in [1, 2]
!foreach $b in ["x", "y"]
A : $a$b
!endfor
!endfor
=== foreach-not-json
--- main
!foreach $x in "abc"
A : $x
!endfor
A : after
=== foreach-endfor-without
--- main
!endfor
=== foreach-missing-in
--- main
!foreach $x [1]
!endfor
=== foreach-var-after
--- main
!foreach $x in [1, 2]
!endfor
A : $x
=== foreach-number
--- main
!foreach $x in 5
!endfor
=== startsub-basic
--- main
!startsub PART1
A -> B : in sub
!endsub
!includesub PART1
=== startsub-bad-name
--- main
!startsub bad-name
!endsub
=== startsub-nested
--- main
!startsub OUTER
!startsub INNER
!endsub
!endsub
=== includesub-missing
--- main
!includesub NOPE
=== endsub-alone
--- main
!endsub
=== startsub-unclosed
--- main
!startsub OPEN
A : in open sub
=== startsub-twice
--- main
!startsub S
A : first
!endsub
!startsub S
A : second
!endsub
!includesub S
